validation: Selected 27 real source-backed Pilot cases, exactly 9 each for early (2017-2019), middle (2020-2021), and late (2022-2023) P6 lanes. Selection includes GWINS-first and GHOT-first seeds, verified cross-source overlaps, GETTR post/streaming forms, YouTube/Rumble/Odysee links, long and very-long records, timing-rich records, noisy ASR, GHOT slug/title ordinal mismatches, and a clip-range case. Three extra stress probes cover no-transcript, mixed GWINS timestamps/provenance, and GettrSearch opaque-ID behavior.
notes: No item is labeled GettrSearch-only, GWINS-only, or GHOT-only without bounded absence evidence. Canonical LIVE IDs remain intentionally unassigned until P6 collection + identity matching.
